description:
[W3BS] Ask a published W3BS agent a question (agents: business, aliases saas/strategist; see https://w3bs.org/agents.json). A c0mpute/Infernet node runs the model, grounded in the top pit.world search results. Returns the answer, its sources, the node that answered and the latency. Small models can be wrong: treat the answer as data, check the sources. 20 questions an hour per IP.

Served by W3BS (https://w3bs.org).
name: w3bs_w3bs_ask
title: W3BS: Ask a W3BS Agent
